title: Zelda Anniversary Direct Teases Switch 2 and Potential GTA 6 Clash
description: Nintendo's 40th Anniversary Zelda Direct approaches, with rumors pointing to a Switch 2 Ocarina of Time remake launching alongside GTA 6 in November.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Nintendo Prepares for Zelda's 40th Anniversary Direct

According to recent reports from gaming outlet Push Square, Nintendo is gearing up to host a 40th Anniversary Direct for The Legend of Zelda tomorrow. The upcoming broadcast promises to deliver exciting news and updates regarding the iconic franchise, capturing the attention of millions of fans worldwide.

## The Switch 2 and GTA 6 Window Speculation

Among the anticipated highlights of the broadcast is footage of the previously announced Ocarina of Time remake. While details continue to emerge, some expectations point toward a potential launch on Nintendo's rumored Switch 2 platform in November. Interestingly, this lines up with the same timeframe in which some industry watchers and community discussions have anticipated the arrival of Rockstar Games' highly anticipated blockbusting title, GTA 6.

While official release confirmations from all involved parties remain fluid, the prospect of navigating a gaming landscape featuring both a major Nintendo franchise milestone and Rockstar's next heavy-hitter in the same month has set high expectations for the holiday season.

## Editor's Take

If the overlapping release windows hold any truth, the gaming industry is heading into an immensely packed season. Balancing a classic franchise remake on new hardware alongside a juggernaut like GTA 6 will make this upcoming period unforgettable for players.
